HDL AutoDoc

Documentation generated from VHDL and SystemVerilog source. These are the example projects, built from the latest main.

example_full — every feature Mixed VHDL / SystemVerilog sampler for ECP5: Mermaid, WaveDrom, FSMs, CDC and reset analysis, interfaces and bus groups, register map, testbenches in four frameworks, Yosys/nextpnr reports. example_ecp5 AXI4-Stream filter with an AXI4-Lite register file for Lattice ECP5, with real build reports. example_sv A SystemVerilog package, interfaces and interface ports. example Traffic light controller and PWM controller: the smallest complete project.
Source and instructions: github.com/FPGA-James/HDLAutoDoc. These builds omit the RTL schematics, which need Yosys.
